implementation.procedure: Replay real scoped/unscoped CLI against exactly four published messages.
implementation.acceptance: Candidate equals full inbox filtered by exact routed FIG-1 task before LIMIT; all kinds and envelope values retained; default unchanged; unselected deliveries pending.

reference_boundary.procedure: Check recipient/task/run identity, SQL-bound task values, all kinds, pending/ACK and pagination.
reference_boundary.acceptance: Unknown task refuses; no ACK/acceptance or global clearance; main retains cross-task coordination and full inbox coverage.

data_integrity.procedure: Check archived source/inputs, exactly two fresh successful raw native turns and provider final accounting.
data_integrity.acceptance: No retries, fabricated usage, cached subtraction or copied prior measurement.

numerical_sanity.procedure: Compare real input+output total and independent exact FIG-1 messages/block oracle.
numerical_sanity.acceptance: Both exact answers pass and candidate total is lower.

measurement_validity.procedure: Compare actual non-task instruction plaintext, tools, model/schema/question and native configuration.
measurement_validity.acceptance: Same server/model/high effort/cwd/profile and all non-task text/catalog; only observed inbox scope differs. Quota before each, first<=25000, paired<=50000, two calls, zero retry, 90s/turn.

reproducibility.procedure: Separate host replays actual CLI/fixture, source/accounting and 4 scope plus 16 existing communication tests without inference.
reproducibility.acceptance: Frozen six-domain plan and independent verification gate; no full-workflow/cash/long-paper claim.

scope: one short synthetic FIG-1 local handling pair; real scoped inbox observations, not global clearance

messages.action: Keep panel 1 consumption blocked until an independent reviewer validates the corrected data.
Read the replacement panel 1 dataset and obtain fresh independent validation; retain the blocker.

success_requires: both exact FIG-1 message/block oracle pass
all actual non-task plaintext and tool catalog hashes match
exact task-filter replay and independent source/quality validation pass
